title: First Repeated Word
statement:
Read a sentence from left to right and find the first word that shows up for the second time.

The input is one line of one or more words separated by spaces. Words match only when they are spelled exactly the same, so `Red` and `red` are different words. Print the word whose second appearance comes earliest in the line. That is not always the word that appears first: in `one two two one`, the answer is `two`. When no word appears twice, print `none`.

Input:

```text
the cat saw the dog and the bird
```

Expected output:

```text
the
```

tests.stdin: the cat saw the dog and the bird

hints: Walk through the words in order and remember every word you have already seen.
A set answers "have I seen this before?" quickly. Check the set before you add the current word to it.
